files.description: Parcel deliveries (240 rows): delivery_id (whole number), city (city name; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), status (exactly "shipped" or "pending", always lower case, no empty cells), parcels (whole number; about 2% empty), express (True or False; about 5% empty).

task_text: Treat an empty express cell as not express. Tidy the city names (remove surrounding spaces and write each word with a capital first letter, as in 'Oslo'). For each city, count the deliveries that are not express. `result` should be a Series of counts indexed by city.
intended_computation: express empty -> False; per tidied city, the number of rows with express False (171 False + 11 empty = 182 in total).

predicted_direction.reason: fillna(False) downcast express to a true/false column on 2.x, so ~ negates it; on 3.x the column stays generic and ~ turns True/False into -2/-1, giving negative counts.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
